pretreatments.description: Ultrasonic assisted KOH pretreatment (KOH_Upt) was applied to wheat straw (WS) with three concentrations of potassium hydroxide (2%, 4%, and 6% w/w) in 1 L bottles. The pH was used to predict the optimum time for pretreatment, which was 36 hours. The process utilized a bath ultrasonication process (KH5200DE, Nanjing Xiao Equipment Company) at ambient temperature of (22 ± 1) °C, constant intensity of 20 kHz, with the water level maintained above the biomass to provide maximum ultrasonication effect throughout the bottles. The samples were mixed thoroughly to attain uniform moisture content and stored at 4 °C after pretreatment.
